1870.s: I have observed, with pain and concern, that your shirt bosom is buttonless; that some of your handkerchiefs are unhemmed; that there are holes in your socks, which your slippers do not conceal, and that your new grey linen blouse is badly ripped behind.

…they were all well dressed, yet there was a certain something about their apparel that had the air of sluggish indifference, as if their wardrobe sighed for the superintending care of some kind female; one man's pocket handkerchief was unhemmed, the ends of another man's cravat were nibbled and ragged, here and there a few holes peeped from the sombre ruffles, and a straggling rent was perceptible in the heels of some stockings.
